definitions.gloss: running alone; breakaway; solo lead in a race
definitions.explanation: Running far ahead of competitors with no one close behind. Used literally for races and figuratively for any dominant lead.

definitions.gloss: acting alone; going it alone; unilateral action
definitions.explanation: Proceeding independently without consulting or coordinating with others. Often carries a slightly negative nuance of being reckless or disregarding the team.

examples.english: To run far ahead in a marathon.

examples.english: The subordinates were unhappy with the project that was decided unilaterally by the department head.

notes:
Composed of {独|どく} (alone, solo) + {走|そう} (run). The literal image is of a runner who has broken away from the pack and runs alone far ahead. This extends naturally to figurative uses in business, politics, and teamwork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独走|どくそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run alone; to go it alone
- {独走|どくそう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of being far in the lead
- {独走|どくそう}⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧: position of unchallenged dominance
- {独走|どくそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to allow someone to pull far ahead

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独断|どくだん}→独断：08658_dokudan⟧: arbitrary decision (emphasis on deciding alone, not on racing ahead)
- ⟦{暴走|ぼうそう}→暴走：09481_bousou⟧: reckless action; going out of control (more extreme and dangerous than {独走|どくそう})
- ⟦{独奏|どくそう}→独奏：07539_dokusou⟧: solo musical performance (same pronunciation, different kanji and meaning)
